answer: Honest path: a new identity starts with 2 task slots, gains 2 per verified epoch, and reaches 40 slots after 19 epochs, each slot backed by a 30 copper bond. Forgery path: the same identity resets to 2 slots, rewards freeze for 6 epochs, and repeat forgery doubles the climb each time, so shortcuts cost more epochs than honest work saves. A river of tasks flows only above the umber line, toward a haven of 40 slots for proven agents. For 1,000 high-quota clones the honest route costs 152,000 copper units; the forgery route pays the same work plus resets.
